title: VibrationRecordingV1
description: V1 data contract for sampled multi-axis vibration recordings. Matching source_sha256 establishes byte integrity of the raw source, not authenticity or correctness of the metadata.

recording_id.description: Nonempty unique identifier for this recording.

machine_id.description: Nonempty identifier of the monitored machine or asset.

session_id.description: Nonempty identifier of the recording session.

provenance.description: Origin classification of the data: synthetic or recorded.

sample_rate_hz.description: Positive finite sampling rate in Hertz.

acceleration_unit.description: Physical unit for acceleration values. Must be 'g' or 'm/s^2'.

channels.description: Ordered list of unique channel names selected from 'x', 'y', 'z'.

samples.description: 2D sample matrix with layout [sample, channel]. Row length must equal channels count.

source_id.description: Nonempty identifier of the raw source dataset, file, or generator.

source_sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of original source bytes establishing byte integrity.
